g.text: Two roles, two zones, no public IPs — and a few choices you cannot take back after create
OS disk 30 GB Standard SSD, encrypted
OS disk 30 GB Standard SSD, encrypted
Neither VM has a public IP. Administration goes through the Bastion in the hub, over the peering.
zone fixed at create — moving a VM to another zone means rebuilding it
VM size resizable, but only within families the current host cluster supports
OS disk type can change, but the VM must be deallocated first
az CLI — note --zone and the absence of a public IP
# --public-ip-address "" is what keeps the VM off the internet
